name: bexio
description: bexio — the Swiss SMB business suite used by 100,000+ companies: contacts, invoices, quotes, orders, articles, projects and timesheets. REST API, bearer token, amounts in CHF.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Sign in to bexio and open **Einstellungen → Apps & Tools → API-Zugriff**.
2. Create an **API token** (for a single company) and copy it into `BEXIO_API_TOKEN`. The token inherits the permissions of the user it was created under, so a read-only agent should get a read-only bexio user.
3. For a multi-tenant integration bexio also offers OAuth 2.0 with per-scope consent; this adapter uses the simpler API token, which is what a single company needs.

**Mixed API versions.** bexio has migrated its resources one at a time, so the path segment differs per object: contacts and articles live under `/2.0/`, invoices under `/2.0/kb_invoice`, and newer resources under `/3.0/` or `/4.0/`. The tools below carry the correct version in each path — do not assume one prefix works for everything.

**Searching**: bexio's list endpoints accept `order_by`, `limit` and `offset`, and each resource has a sibling `/search` endpoint that takes a POST body of `[{field, value, criteria}]`. This adapter exposes the list endpoints; for a precise field match use `bexio_search_contacts`.

**Currency**: bexio is Swiss and most companies book in CHF. Amounts come back as decimal strings — parse, do not round in the prompt.

**Writes**: `bexio_create_contact` writes to the live company. Invoices are not creatable here: bexio requires positions to be posted separately and a half-created invoice is worse than none.

**Cloud reachability**: api.bexio.com is public with a valid certificate; AnythingMCP Cloud reaches it directly.

tools.name: bexio_get_company_profile
tools.description: Read the company profile of the connected bexio account: legal name, address, VAT number and country. Fast call with no parameters — use it to verify the token.

tools.name: bexio_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, private persons) with paging and sorting. Contact type 1 is a company, 2 a private person.

tools.name: bexio_search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by an exact or partial field match — the right tool when you know a name, customer number or e-mail and need the bexio contact id.

value.description: Value to match against that field.

tools.name: bexio_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact by its bexio id, including both name lines, address, contact group membership and the assigned user.

tools.name: bexio_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (Rechnungen) with their document number, total, currency and payment state. Sort by `id_desc` for the most recent first.

order_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. `id_desc` or `is_valid_from`.

tools.name: bexio_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice in full, including every position with its article, quantity, unit price, discount and tax, plus the totals and the due date.

tools.name: bexio_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes (Offerten) with their number, addressee, total and status, to see what is out with customers and not yet won.

tools.name: bexio_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (Aufträge) with their number, customer, total and whether they have already been invoiced.

tools.name: bexio_list_articles
tools.description: List articles from the bexio product catalogue with their internal code, purchase and sale price, stock level and unit.

tools.name: bexio_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their client, responsible user, start and end date and current status — the anchor for any timesheet question.

tools.name: bexio_list_timesheets
tools.description: List tracked time entries with their user, date, duration, project and billability — the raw data behind 'how much did we spend on this client'.

tools.name: bexio_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact in the live bexio company. Search with bexio_search_contacts first — bexio does not deduplicate, and a second 'Muster AG' is painful to unwind.

contact_type_id.description: 1 for a company, 2 for a private person.

name_1.description: Company name, or family name for a private person.

name_2.description: Second name line: given name, or a department.

user_id.description: bexio user id the contact is assigned to.
